Your medication sets a clear safety boundary.

customer.healthScore.findings.DIURETIC_M.defaultMessage: Diuretics can lower magnesium and potassium over time. Your plan keeps an eye on those minerals so your formula complements your medication rather than working against it.

customer.healthScore.findings.ENERGY_UPS.defaultMessage: Your low energy lines up with {energy_causes} — not a missing stimulant. Your energy problem isn’t a caffeine problem.

customer.healthScore.findings.KIDNEY_CEI.defaultMessage: Because you reported reduced kidney function, several minerals are kept within careful dose ceilings. Your plan is built to support you without ever crossing that line.
Your plan respects a hard safety boundary.

customer.healthScore.findings.LIVER_ROUT.defaultMessage: With a liver condition noted, certain botanicals and doses are handled with extra caution. Safety is applied as a filter first, before any recommendation.
Your plan routes carefully around liver safety.

customer.healthScore.findings.METFORMIN_.defaultMessage: Long-term metformin use is associated with lower vitamin B12 over time. Your plan factors that in, so your formula reflects how your body actually handles nutrients — not a generic template.
Your medication shapes one specific nutrient choice.

customer.healthScore.findings.PLANT_OMEG.defaultMessage: Eating mostly plant-based with little oily fish makes omega-3 (EPA/DHA) and vitamin B12 the two nutrients worth getting right. Your plan emphasises exactly these, so the way you eat stays an asset, not a gap.
Your plant-forward diet has two specific blind spots.

customer.healthScore.findings.PPI_B12_MA.defaultMessage: You reported a PPI (acid-reducing medication), which over time can blunt how well you absorb vitamin B12 and magnesium. Your plan accounts for that directly rather than assuming everything you take is fully absorbed.
Your medication quietly affects how you absorb nutrients.

customer.healthScore.findings.PREGNANCY..defaultMessage: Because you are pregnant or breastfeeding, every ingredient is screened against strict safety rules. Nothing is recommended that is not appropriate for this stage — this is the most conservative routing we apply.
Your plan follows strict pregnancy-safe routing.

customer.healthScore.findings.SLEEP_UPST.defaultMessage: Your answers put short or restless sleep at the centre of the pattern. Your plan treats it as the lever it is — because lifting sleep tends to pull energy, focus and mood up with it.
Better sleep is upstream of almost everything you asked for.

customer.healthScore.findings.STATIN_COQ.defaultMessage: Because you reported a statin ''and'' low energy, your plan does not get a generic “men’s health” stack. It specifically reviews CoQ10 — which statins are known to deplete — alongside heart-aware nutrient choices. This is the kind of interaction a one-size quiz never checks, and it is why your formula will look different from your friend’s.
Your statin answer changed the entire review.

customer.healthScore.findings.VITD_ROUTI.defaultMessage: Daily sunscreen, limited time in the sun, and low oily-fish intake all point the same way — so your plan leans into vitamin D and omega-3 support rather than guessing. Your formula is built around how you actually live, not just your age and sex.
Your daily routine shapes your formula.

customer.healthScore.findings.WEIGHT_PAT.defaultMessage: Your pattern points less to willpower and more to the daily rhythm around movement, sleep and meals. Your plan targets that rhythm rather than handing you another restrictive rulebook.

customer.landing.bridge.body.defaultMessage: Start with a short, detailed questionnaire and your free Health Score. Your personalised plan — and the option to add Living Protocol — is one step away.

customer.landing.bridge.note.defaultMessage: Free to start — no credit card required.

customer.landing.bridge.title.defaultMessage: Ready to design your Right Amount?

customer.landing.clarity.body.defaultMessage: Walk into a drugstore or look online and it’s overwhelming. MattaNutra guides you from hundreds of options down to the few that are right and personalised for you. Knowing the Right Amount.

customer.landing.clarity.cards.0.body.defaultMessage: Hundreds of options, no clear answer.

customer.landing.clarity.cards.2.body.defaultMessage: Only what your body actually needs.

customer.landing.clarity.cards.3.imageAl.defaultMessage: Exactly what you need, in hand

customer.landing.difference.paragraphs.0.defaultMessage: Anyone can look up whether travel affects magnesium. The hard part is knowing how it affects your plan — your stack, your medications, the weeks you've just had — and what to actually do about it. That's the part Living Protocol handles for you.

customer.landing.difference.paragraphs.1.defaultMessage: It already knows everything you take, so there's nothing to re-explain each time something changes. Every adjustment it suggests is checked against your medications and lab flags — the kind of safety net that only works when the guidance is built around you. Over 90 days it comes to recognise your patterns, so its advice reflects not just this week but the trend behind it. And you never have to know the right question to ask — you simply say what's going on, and Living Protocol does the thinking.

customer.landing.difference.paragraphs.2.defaultMessage: You don't need to become your own pharmacist. You just tell MattaNutra what's changed, and it keeps your protocol right.

customer.landing.faq.items.0.1.defaultMessage: Yes. Your assessment is yours. We don't sell answers, we don't share with advertisers, and you can request deletion at any time. Living Protocol conversations are stored only to maintain continuity in your plan.

customer.landing.faq.items.1.0.defaultMessage: I'm on medication — is this safe for me?

customer.landing.faq.items.1.1.defaultMessage: MattaNutra screens for the most common medication–supplement considerations and flags them in your plan. It is wellness guidance, not medical advice. If you are taking prescription medication, pregnant, nursing, or managing a medical condition, please consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning any supplement programme.

customer.landing.faq.items.2.0.defaultMessage: Where do the recommended products come from?

customer.landing.faq.items.2.1.defaultMessage: Your formula is dispensed through a partner pharmacy network with registered pharmacists, so you collect exactly what your plan calls for — with no guessing in the aisle. We don't manufacture supplements ourselves; we match you to trusted products and a pharmacist who can answer your questions.

customer.landing.faq.items.3.0.defaultMessage: Is the free assessment really free?

customer.landing.faq.items.3.1.defaultMessage: Yes. The questionnaire and your Health Score are free, and no credit card is required. After you complete it, you'll see where you stand and a starting direction. The full personalised Right Amount Formula — and optional Living Protocol support — are available if you choose to go further.

customer.landing.faq.items.4.1.defaultMessage: “Mattaññutā” means knowing the right amount. It comes from a 2,500-year-old tradition of practical wisdom about moderation and balance — the idea that flourishing comes not from more, but from exactly enough. The name is our promise: we'll help you find your right amount, not sell you more of what you don't need.

customer.landing.final.body.defaultMessage: Answer a focused set of questions, get your free Health Score, and receive your personalised starting plan — built around your body, your goals, and your day.

customer.landing.food.cards.0.1.defaultMessage: Pumpkin seeds, spinach and black beans are some of the richest natural sources.

customer.landing.food.cards.1.1.defaultMessage: It turns up in unexpected places — grape juice, broccoli and whole grains.

customer.landing.food.cards.2.1.defaultMessage: If your meals are doing the job, Living Protocol will tell you to skip the supplement — and save your money.

customer.landing.food.imageAlt.defaultMessage: A nourishing bowl with fish, greens, broccoli, black beans, brown rice and pumpkin seeds

customer.landing.food.intro.defaultMessage: Supplements fill the gaps — but food fills them first. When Living Protocol spots something your body needs, it doesn't just reach for a capsule. It tells you which everyday foods are naturally rich in it, so you can choose: top up at dinner, or top up from the bottle. Either way, you're finally knowing, not guessing.

customer.landing.food.note.defaultMessage: No food diary. No calorie counting. Just a quick answer when you want one, and a nudge toward the right plate when it helps.

customer.landing.hero.intro.defaultMessage: Supplement and wellness plans built around your body, your lifestyle, and the goals that actually matter to you — and that adapt as your life does.

customer.landing.hero.microcopy.defaultMessage: Start with a free Health Score that shows where you stand. Your personalised Right Amount Formula is ready when you are.

customer.landing.hero.pali.defaultMessage: Pāli for the wisdom of knowing the right amount — that wellbeing comes not from more, but from exactly enough.

customer.landing.how.intro.defaultMessage: From a short, focused questionnaire to recommendations you can trust — in four steps.

customer.landing.how.steps.0.2.defaultMessage: A genuinely detailed set of questions — your goals & health priorities, lifestyle & activity, current medications, budget, and what you truly care about. Thorough enough to personalise your formula, with no jargon and no fluff.

customer.landing.how.steps.1.2.defaultMessage: A proprietary algorithm — grounded in published clinical research — designed to closely match the supplement priorities a blood panel would surface, with dosage ranges and safety checks.

customer.landing.how.steps.2.2.defaultMessage: Your formula is dispensed through a partner pharmacy with registered pharmacists — real people you can ask, not a guess in the aisle.

customer.landing.how.steps.3.2.defaultMessage: With Living Protocol, your plan keeps adjusting as your goals, symptoms and lifestyle change over time.

customer.landing.origin.body.defaultMessage: MattaNutra began in northern Thailand, where traditions of moderation — eating just enough, resting at the right hour, working with the body's own rhythms — have been quietly refined over centuries.

customer.landing.origin.body2.defaultMessage: We built MattaNutra to translate that quiet wisdom into something modern, measurable, and personal: a plan that learns your body, adjusts when life shifts, and never asks you to become someone you're not.

customer.landing.origin.founderParagraph.defaultMessage: What goes into your body should be designed by people who understand what's actually in it.

MattaNutra was founded by an international group with an unusually broad foundation: two physicians with MD–PhD training from leading research institutions (including Mahidol, Princeton, Stanford and Harvard Universities), a software engineer whose career began at CERN and now spans AI and decentralised systems for institutions including Goldman Sachs and UBS, a PhD economist with global enterprise experience across public markets and frontier ventures, and a younger founder whose perspective keeps us close to the generation we're building for.
Between us, more than a hundred years of professional practice — in medicine, in science, in technology, and in the rewarding work of building things that last.
